modalLead: A calmer health page (same treatment as config) and much lighter page loads: text responses are now gzip-compressed, so pages transfer 70-90% smaller.

items.text: Compressed page loads — the server now gzip-compresses HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and API responses when your browser supports it (which every modern browser does). Typical files transfer 70-90% smaller (for example the main search script drops from ~98 KB to ~19 KB), so the dashboard and config load noticeably faster, especially over slower connections. Already-compressed files like fonts and images are left as-is.

Quieter health borders — the health page had a frame around the intro, every stat tile, the filter bar, and the bookmark panel all at once. Borders are now softer and reserved for the tiles and outer panels; the intro drops its frame and sections are separated by spacing and headings, matching the config cleanup. Filters, pills, the active tile highlight, and action buttons stay crisp.
